ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff/Sapphire Sleet 'Snatch Crypto' recruiter ISO mount → DLL side-load chain
ucs.description: Hunts the Bluenoroff (Sapphire Sleet / TA444 / APT38) recruiter-pretext delivery chain documented by Kaspersky and Microsoft: a fake LinkedIn recruiter sends a job-themed ISO/IMG/VHD to a crypto/fintech employee; on mount, a LNK launches a renamed legitimate signed Windows binary from the mounted volume which side-loads an attacker DLL adjacent to it. This catches the explorer-spawned execution off a non-system drive correlated with the container drop and the same-folder DLL load.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as drop_time values(Filesystem.file_name) as iso_file values(Filesystem.file_path) as iso_folder from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action IN ("created","renamed","write") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.iso" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.img" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.vhd" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.vhdx") AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Desktop\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Public\\*") by Filesystem.dest | rename Filesystem.dest as host | join type=inner host [ | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as exec_time values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.process_name) as mounted_binary values(Processes.process_path) as mounted_path values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" AND (Processes.process_path="D:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="E:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="F:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="G:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="H:\\*") AND NOT match(Processes.user,"\$$") by Processes.dest | rename Processes.dest as host ] | where exec_time>=drop_time AND exec_time<=drop_time+7200 | table drop_time exec_time host user iso_file iso_folder mounted_binary mounted_path cmdline sha256
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 48h;
let Containers = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)\.(iso|img|vhd|vhdx)$"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Desktop\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Public\")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              IsoName = FileName, IsoFolder = FolderPath, IsoSHA256 = SHA256,
              Dropper = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let MountExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
    | where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
    | project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              MountedBinary = FileName, MountedBinaryPath = FolderPath,
              ExecCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ExecSHA256 = SHA256,
              SignerCompany = ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName;
let SideLoad = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | project LoadTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              SideLoadedDLL = FileName, SideLoadedDLLPath = FolderPath, SideLoadedSHA256 = SHA256,
              LoaderImage = InitiatingProcessFileName, LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath;
Containers
| join kind=inner MountExec on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + 2h)
| join kind=inner SideLoad on DeviceId
| where LoadTime between (ExecTime .. ExecTime + 5m)
| where LoaderPath =~ MountedBinaryPath        // DLL adjacent to the loader on the mount
| where SideLoadedDLLPath =~ MountedBinaryPath
| project DropTime, ExecTime, LoadTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          IsoName, IsoFolder, IsoSHA256,
          MountedBinary, SignerCompany, MountedBinaryPath, ExecSHA256,
          SideLoadedDLL, SideLoadedSHA256, ExecCmd
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 48h;
let Containers = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)\.(iso|img|vhd|vhdx)$"
    | where TargetFilePath matches regex @"(?i)\\(Downloads|Desktop|Temp|Public)\\"
    | project DropTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              IsoName = TargetFileName, IsoPath = TargetFilePath;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName =~ "explorer.exe"
| where TargetProcessName matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
| join kind=inner Containers on $left.DvcHostname == $right.DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (DropTime .. DropTime + 2h)
| project DropTime, ExecTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          IsoName, IsoPath, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Bluenoroff/Sapphire Sleet Recruiter ISO - Process Spawned by Explorer from Mounted Volume
id: b1ue-no12-sl1d-eloa-d000sapphire01
status: experimental
description: Detects processes spawned by explorer.exe from a non-system drive (D:-Z:), consistent with Bluenoroff (Sapphire Sleet / TA444 / APT38) recruiter-pretext ISO/IMG mount + side-loaded DLL chain (Snatch Crypto campaign).
references:
  - https://securelist.com/the-bluenoroff-cryptocurrency-hunt-is-still-on/105488/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.g0098
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
    Image|re: '^[D-Z]:\\\\'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate installers run from optical/removable installation media
  - IT-staged USB provisioning sequences
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE) @Image:(D\:\\* OR d\:\\* OR E\:\\* OR e\:\\* OR F\:\\* OR f\:\\* OR G\:\\* OR g\:\\* OR H\:\\* OR h\:\\*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^explorer\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/^[D-Z]:\\/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten | TargetFileName=/\.(iso|img|vhd|vhdx)$/i | TargetFileName=/\\(Downloads|Desktop|Temp|Public)\\/i}, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, TargetFileName, SHA256HashData], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff/APT38 'AppleJeus' trojanized cryptocurrency trading app execution + outbound beacon
ucs.description: Hunts execution of any binary from the AppleJeus family of trojanized cryptocurrency trading applications operated by Bluenoroff (APT38 / TA444 / BeagleBoyz) since 2018 — cloned-company facades (Celas, JMT Trading, Union Crypto, Kupay, CoinGoTrade, Dorusio, BloxHolder, AlticGO, Mokupay, Ants2Whale). Pairs the process-create with a same-process outbound HTTPS to a public IP within 30 minutes to confirm live beacon, not just an installer artifact.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as first_run values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.process_path) as image_path values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("CelasTradePro.exe","JMTTrader.exe","JMTTrading.exe","UnionCryptoTrader.exe","UnionCryptoUpdater.exe","KupayWallet.exe","Kupay.exe","CoinGoTrade.exe","Dorusio.exe","BloxHolder.exe","AlticGO.exe","Mokupay.exe","Ants2Whale.exe","TraderTrip.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.process_name | rename Processes.dest as host Processes.process_name as process_name | join type=outer host [ | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as first_egress values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dest_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dest_port values(All_Traffic.app) as process_seen from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal" AND All_Traffic.app IN ("CelasTradePro.exe","JMTTrader.exe","JMTTrading.exe","UnionCryptoTrader.exe","UnionCryptoUpdater.exe","KupayWallet.exe","Kupay.exe","CoinGoTrade.exe","Dorusio.exe","BloxHolder.exe","AlticGO.exe","Mokupay.exe","Ants2Whale.exe","TraderTrip.exe") by All_Traffic.src | rename All_Traffic.src as host ] | where first_egress >= first_run AND first_egress <= first_run + 1800 | table first_run first_egress host user process_name image_path cmdline sha256 dest_ip dest_port
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let AppleJeusBinaries = dynamic([
    "celastradepro.exe","jmttrader.exe","jmttrading.exe",
    "unioncryptotrader.exe","unioncryptoupdater.exe",
    "kupaywallet.exe","kupay.exe",
    "coingotrade.exe","coingotrade_setup.exe",
    "dorusio.exe","dorusio_setup.exe",
    "bloxholder.exe","blocktrading.exe",
    "alticgo.exe","mokupay.exe",
    "ants2whale.exe","tradertrip.exe"
]);
let AppleJeusCompanies = dynamic([
    "celas","jmt trading","union crypto","kupay",
    "coingotrade","dorusio","bloxholder","alticgo",
    "mokupay","ants2whale"
]);
let Execs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (AppleJeusBinaries)
       or tolower(ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName) has_any (AppleJeusCompanies)
       or tolower(ProcessVersionInfoProductName) has_any (AppleJeusCompanies)
    | project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              AppName = FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
              SignerCompany = ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
              Product = ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
              ExecCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
Execs
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort,
              NetProc = InitiatingProcessFileName, NetSHA = InitiatingProcessSHA256
  ) on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (ExecTime .. ExecTime + 30m)
| where NetSHA == SHA256                 // same binary beaconing out
| project ExecTime, BeaconTime = NetTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          AppName, FolderPath, SHA256, SignerCompany, Product, ExecCmd,
          RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
| order by ExecTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let AppleJeusBinaries = dynamic([
    "CelasTradePro.exe","JMTTrader.exe","JMTTrading.exe",
    "UnionCryptoTrader.exe","UnionCryptoUpdater.exe",
    "KupayWallet.exe","Kupay.exe","CoinGoTrade.exe",
    "Dorusio.exe","BloxHolder.exe","AlticGO.exe",
    "Mokupay.exe","Ants2Whale.exe","TraderTrip.exe"
]);
let Execs = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | extend BinaryName = tostring(split(TargetProcessName, '\\')[-1])
    | where BinaryName in~ (AppleJeusBinaries)
       or tolower(ActingProcessFileCompany) has_any ("celas","jmt trading","union crypto","kupay","bloxholder","alticgo","mokupay","dorusio","ants2whale")
    | project ExecTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              BinaryName, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256 = tostring(SHA256);
Execs
| join kind=leftouter (
    ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where NetworkDirection == "Outbound"
    | where not(ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr))
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, Url
  ) on DvcHostname
| where NetTime between (ExecTime .. ExecTime + 30m)
| project ExecTime, BeaconTime = NetTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          BinaryName, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256,
          DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, Url
| order by ExecTime desc
